presentation.label: MIDI CC to effect page 2
presentation.summary: Map incoming MIDI CC 68–73 to FX1 page-2 parameters. The upstream FX2 block requires BusDelay or BusVerb, outside Octamod's scope.
presentation.overview: CC Map maps incoming MIDI CCs on audio tracks' trig channels to effect page-2 parameters, respecting AUDIO CC IN and clamping values. It writes Part, live and shadow values and marks the Part changed. This source draft is unavailable until qualification, LCD evidence, integration and owner review are complete.
highlights: CC 68–73 address FX1 page-2 slots 6–11 for a non-NONE FX1.
Writes every audio track whose trig channel matches the message.
Clamps values using the target effect's parameter limits.
Passes CCs outside 62–73 to the next handler.
usage: On the verified MKII emulator panel, press PROJ, choose MIDI, press RIGHT, choose CONTROL and press YES. Enable AUDIO CC IN with LEVEL.
In MIDI > CHANNELS, match the target audio track’s TRIG CH to the controller. The captured T1 uses channel 1, independently of AUTO CH 11.
Select T1 and FILTER in FUNC+FX1 SETUP. Send CC 68 value 1 on channel 1, then close/reopen SETUP: HP changes from 12 dB to 24 dB. Hardware/audio/persistence qualification remains pending.

access.location: MKII: PROJ > MIDI > CONTROL enables AUDIO CC IN; MIDI > CHANNELS sets the audio track’s TRIG CH. FUNC+FX1 opens effect page-2 SETUP.
steps: On the MKII panel, press PROJ. Select MIDI with UP/DOWN and press RIGHT to enter its list.
Select CONTROL and press YES. Select AUDIO CC IN and turn LEVEL until its checkbox is enabled.
Press NO to return to MIDI, select CHANNELS and press YES. Match the target audio track’s TRIG CH to the external controller. The captured T1 uses channel 1; AUTO CH 11 is a different setting.
Press NO twice to return to the track. Press T1, then hold FUNC and press FX1 for FX1 SETUP. Turn LEVEL to FILTER and press YES to assign it.
FILTER SETUP shows page-2 HP, LP, ENV, HOLD, Q and DIST. Send CC 68 value 1 on channel 1 to change HP from 12 dB to 24 dB.
Close SETUP with FX1 and reopen with FUNC+FX1 to refresh the displayed HP value. The cave omits the stock editor’s redraw call.
These steps were verified only for the isolated MKII emulator UI. Qualify audio, Part save/reload, MKI access and real hardware separately before publication.

limitations: Draft only: unavailable in the catalog and firmware builds pending full qualification, integration and owner approval. Actual MKII emulator UI captures are included.
CC 62–67 write FX2 page 2 only for BusDelay/BusVerb, which are outside scope and not imported. Current catalog/stock FX2 support is not claimed.
CC 62–73 are consumed even if AUDIO CC IN is disabled or the track's effect has no eligible target.
All Octamod combinations and hook/placement behavior are unverified, including MIDI Scenes, Scale Quantizer, OctaKit and USB MIDI/Audio.
Upstream MODE DEFAULTS and SCENES KITS overrides are not imported or enabled.
Upstream leaves hardware SCENES KITS chaining and FX1-to-DSP updates on THRU tracks open.

storage.label: Authored cave reference
storage.conditions: The isolated capture build linked 724 bytes, matching the authored 712-byte code oracle plus two six-byte count tables. This excludes complete placement/padding/stack/shared-state memory accounting; the four-byte dispatch poke replaces an existing vector.

processing.label: ColdFire MIDI processing
processing.conditions: No current-version worst-case event counts or real-time budgets cover channel-map rebuilding, up to eight matching tracks, modulation, effect/Part/mode changes, MIDI bursts and maximum audio/MIDI/USB load.

tests.summary: Historical upstream MKII use is retained. Current isolated emulator LCD captures document MIDI enable/channel settings and one CC68-to-FILTER HP write. Worst-case cycles, complete memory, a 60-minute eight-track hardware stress project, native/browser parity and combinations remain unqualified.
